headline: Can Europe RECHARGE 🔋 Its BATTERY 🍆 Industry? 🌍
text:
FORWARDS FESTIVAL 🎡 in BRISTOL 🏙️ is finally getting its BATTERIES 🍆 CHARGED 🔋 by clean energy ⚡ this weekend 🌞 as 60000 ravers 🕺 descend for the event 🎟️!! Massive Attack's Robert Del Naja 🧔 known around here as BATTERY DADDY 🔋🐺 has been EDGING 👐 the entire music industry 🎸 toward systemic change since their world record gig 🏆 that slashed power emissions by a whopping 98 PERCENT 📉 by going 100 PERCENT battery powered 🔋 and 100 PERCENT vegan munchies 🌱!! Their 2024 ACT 1.5 show left the carbon footprint smaller than a microdick 🍆 and now every single stage at Forwards is running on green hydrogen technology 🟢 and a whole fleet of scalable rechargeable BATTERIES 🍆 that are basically railing 💦 the diesel generators right out of the game!! Other big events like Love Saves the Day ❤️ and the Bristol International Balloon Fiesta 🎈 have also ditched the dirty generators for this green tech 🌿 after a record breaking summer of prolonged HEAT 🔥 and dry weather that left everyone down bad for climate action ☀️!!

BATTERY DADDY 🔋🐺 said their whole set was always about creating permanent legacy of decarbonisation 🏛️ and it's so GRATIFYING 😩 to see festivals across Bristol getting railed 💦 by this renewable wave 🌊!! The stages are powered by pioneering GeoPura green hydrogen 🚀 plus those fat stacks of batteries that can SCALE 🧗‍♂️ up to handle Lorde 🎤 Little Simz 🐝 Tems 🔥 and Goldie spinning all night without a single puff of dirty diesel smoke 🚬!! This whole transformation got funded by the Clean Power Pilot 💰 run by the West of England Combined Authority with Weca mayor Helen Godwin 👩‍💼 stepping up like the climate mommy 🍼 we all needed!! After another exceptionally hot and dry summer that screamed human induced climate change 🌡️ everyone can literally SEE ☀️ how our weather is getting absolutely COOKED 🍳 and it's time to recharge the whole battery industry across Europe before it stays limp forever ⚡!!

Weca mayor Helen Godwin dropped the quote 🔥 saying after this scorcher summer everyone can see our climate is straight up CHANGING 🌍 so they brought the brilliant creative industries 🎨 together with clean energy sectors ⚡ to tackle the crisis and literally clean up the air we breathe 🫁!! She added that the West of England has always been a region that CARES 💖 about our environment and clean energy and clean air but we also LOVE 🥰 to have a good time getting down at festivals 🕺 without choking on dirty exhaust!! Producing dirty air straight up affects people's health 🩹 so they're thinking of innovative clean ways that let us party harder while the batteries get railed 💦 all night long!! The ambition is to expand this model by 2027 stretching it across multiple sectors and paving the way for the UK and international adoption so Europe can finally recharge its entire battery game 🍆🔋!!

The duo from Massive Attack are hoping more events will jump on these sustainable options after watching their ripple effect turn into a full on wave crashing across Bristol this weekend 🌊!! From selling only vegan food 🌱 to running every stage on battery power the 2024 show smashed the record for lowest ever carbon emissions at a gig 🏆 and now Forwards Festival is living proof that the dream is real!! Helen Godwin wrapped it up by reminding us we're trying to think of fresh ways to keep the good times rolling without wrecking the planet and that message is hitting different after this brutal summer of heat 🔥!! So yeah Europe better start stroking those battery initiatives the same way because this green tech is about to make the whole industry bust the biggest clean nut of the decade 💦🌍!!
